newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Umbono announces management change.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Umbono announces management change.

text.p: Umbono Investment Corp Ltd said on Thursday its chairman and managing director Charles Allison and finance director Andrew Mari had left the company.
A company notice said the two had left "to pursue their own interests".
It said Letsema Investments had been appointed with immediate effect to manage Umbono.

The notice said Allison and Mari had acquired an equity interest in EcoBlend (Pty) Ltd -- the company in which Umbono said last Friday it had agreed to invest 5.01 million rand by subscribing for 20.4 percent of its shares.
